sourceAuthority.units: Frontmatter px values preserve numeric WPF DIP values. Padding uses top/right/bottom/left order.
sourceAuthority.preview: Native WPF source is authoritative; no HTML/CSS preview is supplied.

highContrast.evaluation: SystemParameters.HighContrast is evaluated at construction; ApplyHighContrastPalette sets the window flag and resource mappings.
highContrast.artwork: Use GenericArtwork while the window's high-contrast palette is active.
highContrast.captureLimit: setup-system-colors.png calls the mapping with current system colors; it does not verify an OS contrast-mode transition.

focus.layout: Separate non-hit-testable ring; control border and layout dimensions do not change.
focus.restoration: After an operation, restore the initiating button only when visible and enabled, the window is active, and keyboard focus was previously within the window.

nativeMotion.customTransitions: None; text and native control states update without added motion.
nativeMotion.preparation: The native progress indicator is indeterminate only when SystemParameters.ClientAreaAnimation is true and SystemParameters.HighContrast is false.

nativeAccessibility.announcement: The main instruction's accessible name includes visible status; unchanged announcements are suppressed and LiveRegionChanged is raised when listeners exist.

iconProvenance.device: Native XAML Canvas/Path/Ellipse/DrawingBrush geometry authored from the directly approved minimal-installer-v2-final.xaml. Model AudioAccessory5,1 only while the window's high-contrast palette is inactive.
iconProvenance.fallback: GenericArtwork is native XAML speaker Path geometry for other/unselected models and high contrast.
iconProvenance.play: Native XAML Path, 8 × 10 DIP, with a 10-DIP label gap.
iconProvenance.shippingRasters: These setup controls introduce no raster assets.

verification.boundary: Existing compiled-WPF client captures use a mock platform; native whole-window chrome is not captured. No fresh UI, audio, hardware or backend validation was performed for documentation.
verification.qualityBar: No independent QUALITY BAR card or native Windows reference packet was supplied; no independent ceiling pass is claimed.

narrative.overview:
AppleHome's setup carries the user's chosen Apple Devices reference through one white field, centered device identity, precise native type and restrained blue actions. The directly user-approved final concept establishes the direction; the WPF implementation establishes exact values.

NativeSetupWindow.xaml and NativeSetupWindow.cs are the implementation authority. The approved visual authority is artifacts/design-minimal-installer-20261020/minimal-installer-v2-final.png and its editable .xaml. Portable px notation below preserves numeric WPF device-independent pixel (DIP) values; padding uses top/right/bottom/left order. No HTML/CSS implementation or preview is supplied.
keyCharacteristics: One white field with centered device identity and task feedback.
Native vector HomePod mini artwork with a monochrome speaker fallback.
A prominent listening question and a quieter model line.
Distinct replay, secondary and primary actions with visible keyboard focus.
Native Windows controls and accessible text feedback.

rules.name: The System Contrast Rule
rules.body: When high contrast is active at window creation, apply the implemented Windows SystemColors mappings and use the monochrome speaker fallback. The system-colors capture exercises explicit mapping with current colors; it does not verify an OS contrast-mode transition.

rules.name: The Quiet Field Rule
rules.body: Keep the setup body and footer on one continuous field; separate identity, task and actions with spacing and type.

rules.name: The Native Feedback Rule
rules.body: Use text, focus and native control states without added transitions. Preparation is indeterminate only when Windows client-area animation is enabled and high contrast is off.

dos: **Do** carry the approved Apple Devices direction through one white field, centered device identity, precise native type and restrained blue actions.
**Do** reuse the existing WPF brushes and role-specific button styles, including focus and SystemColors mappings.
**Do** preserve native window controls, wrapped feedback, polite announcements and the authored XAML artwork with its fallback.
**Do** keep replay separate from explicit hearing confirmation.
donts: **Don't** restore the superseded silver surround and grouped task card as visual authority.
**Don't** turn the HomePod drawing's shading into decorative panel elevation.
**Don't** override Windows contrast colors with fixed light-palette values when high contrast is active.
**Don't** make a browser implementation authoritative for these native controls.
